country.evidence_quote: Terry began his Marathon of Hope in 1980. Today, it continues through people across Canada and around the world who run, donate and fundraise, and the researchers they help power. Through the Marathon of Hope Cancer Centres Network, we’re advancing cancer research beyond walls, connecting researchers to share knowledge and accelerate discovery. Together, we’re fuelling the research that will end cancer and finish what Terry started.
